_source: Derived from dev_cost_benchmarks.md §6.1 — agent compiled 2026-04-26 with 55 citations
_basis: Edinburg TX, 4.16 ac combined, 27 townhouse lots, 600 LF interior 50'-ROW streets, 8,850 SF detention, 2026 USD
_assumptions: Mid case: 40' pavement (Edinburg UDC multi-family rule), no lift station required, asphalt over concrete, full city utilities at boundary

range_summary._low_assumptions: 32' pavement, single-family classification, no lift station, smooth HCID abandonment, mild contingency burn
range_summary._high_assumptions: 43' pavement (residential collector), lift station +$200K, complex HCID release, drainage study upsizes detention, 25% contingency burn

24._note: FLOOR — assumes drain ditch easement is adjacent, not on subject

32._note: MAX — Stonecrest yields full 5+ additional lots

carry_assumptions._note: If sellout >12 mo, add $$ for extended carry (avg drawn balance × rate)

pavement_classification.issue: Edinburg UDC requires 40' pavement for multi-family townhomes (mid case used). If single-family classification negotiated, drops to 32'.

lift_station_risk.issue: Desktop research cannot confirm gravity sanitary tie distance to existing trunk.
lift_station_risk.action: Phone Edinburg Planning + walk site to identify existing manholes

hcid_canal_release.issue: HCID No. 1 abandonment process not documented online — could add $15-35K and 60-120 days, OR refuse release entirely

_anchors: TxDOT District 21 Pharr 12-mo avg bid prices (Aug 2024) — 60% of hard cost
